title: Introducing BitGo Link: One Borderless Network, Built to Move Institutional Capital
summary: Link connects institutional clients' accounts at exchanges such as Crypto.com, Kraken, and Coinbase directly to BitGo, extending a unified way to manage their capital across venues to optimize capital movement.
body_markdown:
BitGo is excited to announce the launch of Link, a centralized control layer that connects institutional clients' exchange accounts directly to the BitGo platform. Built for trading, treasury, and portfolio management teams, Link gives institutions a single point to see and move capital across every connected venue. Combined with[BitGo's Go Network](https://www.bitgo.com/products/go-network/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=foundational&utm_campaign=link_gonetwork_blog) , it turns BitGo into one borderless layer for moving capital, and is a direct bridge to[BitGo Prime's global liquidity layer](https://www.bitgo.com/products/prime/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=foundational&utm_campaign=link_prime_blog) , where clients can trade, finance, and manage that capital.


## Key Takeaways


-


A new operating layer: Link connects institutional clients' accounts at exchanges such as Crypto.com, Kraken, and Coinbase directly to BitGo, extending a unified way to manage their capital across venues to optimize capital movement.


-


One network, no borders: Go Network settles transactions and connects clients to liquidity within BitGo's qualified custody, and Link builds on that by letting clients move and control assets on connected exchanges from one place. Together, they form a single, borderless money movement layer, giving clients utility over their capital inside and outside of BitGo.


-


Do more with your assets: Link gives clients the visibility they need to put those assets to work through BitGo Prime's global liquidity layer of trading, financing, and collateral management.


## Institutional Capital Is Scattered Across Venues


Institutional trading and treasury teams rarely operate on a single exchange. Capital sits across BitGo wallets and multiple external venues, each with its own login, permission structure, and settlement process. This leads treasury teams to have to manually check balances and confirm transfers venue by venue. Trading teams lack the real-time, granular visibility into total buying power across venues. And both teams struggle to set up and maintain access controls at each exchange separately, with no centralized record of who can move what, where. That fragmentation slows down trading and treasury operations, while making oversight harder to enforce consistently.


## BitGo Link: One Place to See, Move, and Manage Capital Across Exchanges


Once a client's exchange accounts are connected, Link becomes the single point from which teams see and act on capital across venues.


-


Portfolio-wide visibility: surface buying power across BitGo and connected exchange accounts, down to individual sub-accounts, replacing login-by-login checks with one view.


-


Automated capital management tools: execute one-click transfers from BitGo to rebalance positions, cover margin, or act on a market move, with each transfer reconciled against exchange records and trackable from start to settlement.


-


Secured movement: every transfer runs through BitGo's Policy Engine, so the same approval controls already protecting BitGo wallets applies to exchange transfers too.


-


Centralized governance: manage user roles and enforce security across every connected exchange from a single point, no rebuilding permissions venue by venue.


## A Full-Stack Solution for Institutional Digital Assets


Link is the latest addition to BitGo's full-stack approach to institutional digital assets: regulated qualified custody, secure capital movement through Go Network, and BitGo Prime's global liquidity layer of trading, financing, and collateral management. The result is capital that moves without friction, stays visible, and gets deployed, without ever needing to leave the security of custody. BitGo expects to extend Link to additional exchanges and treasury workflows over time. **About BitGo**


BitGo is the digital asset infrastructure company, delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since our founding in 2013, we have been focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. With a global presence and multiple regulated entities, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of retail investors worldwide.
